text:
incident-bot: Incident OUTAGE-2026-03: All services reported degraded routing to inference clusters. Incident declared 11:45 UTC. Primary mitigation applied (fallback routing + burst capacity). Post-incident follow-up thread started — dropping notes here for handoff and customer comms.

alex: Thanks. short summary from oncall: at 11:42 we saw error spike in node pool us-west-2-gpu-1 — KV cache eviction pathological under a specific seq len pattern. Autoscaler delayed because metrics aggregation lagged. We applied manual scale + reverted a recent kernel bump at 12:05. Traffic normalized by 12:20. :white_check_mark:

sre-jen: Confirming — root cause looks like a regression in kernel selection logic that caused memory to spike for certain prompt patterns. Repro steps in the runbook. We'll schedule RCA. Need to assign action owners.

maria: From product side — two customers reported timeouts impacting user flows (one big account, one mid-market). CS already patched with retries. We should coordinate the customer-facing note and a short status page update summarizing impact and mitigation.

liu-cs: CS notes: affected customers: AcmeCorp (prod writes), BorealisApps (staging). Acme saw increased error rates between 11:40–12:18, ~6% of requests. They asked for an RCA; would like it within 48 hours if possible.

jordan: Ops handoff: I'll take remediation tasks for the autoscaler metrics race condition. Assigning ticket INF-4826. ETA for a patch PR by EOD tomorrow. Will add integration test for metrics staleness.

ops-handoff: I'll own the kernel-selection rollback follow-up and a canary plan to safely reintroduce the kernel after fixes. Ticket INF-4827. Will coordinate with runtime CI to add the failing prompt scenario as a regression test.

alex: Scheduling postmortem meeting: propose 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC (60m). Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, customer comms draft. If that works I’ll create the calendar invite and link the doc.

delilah-support: Please cc legal for AcmeCorp comms. We should include SLA impact language and whether credits are warranted. Also linking the partial status page draft here for review: ``Status: Degraded (resolved). Impact: Intermittent timeouts for text-generation endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigation: Fallback routing and manual scaling applied. ETA for fix: under investigation.``

sre-jen: Action items agreed so far (quick list):
- INF-4826 (jordan) autoscaler race fix + test — due 2026-03-17
- INF-4827 (ops-handoff) kernel-selection rollback analysis + canary plan — due 2026-03-18
- DOC-945 (alex) postmortem writeup and timeline — draft due before the PM meeting
- COMM-311 (maria + liu-cs + delilah-support) customer status note & RCA share plan — initial draft in 24h

maria: For the customer note: short high-level timeline, what we did to mitigate, what's next, and offer a follow-up RCA. Keep it non-technical but include token-level impact for Acme if CS provides it.

liu-cs: I'll pull usage numbers and error-rate graphs. Expect a data snapshot by 14:00 UTC today. That will help quantify impact for Acme.

alex: Draft postmortem link: https://redwood.company/postmortems/INF-2026-03-11-kernel-regression (I'll populate after the meeting). Please add any logs/traces under attachments.

sre-jen: Quick mitigation notes for the postmortem draft (pasteable):
```
Timeline:
11:42 — Elevated 5xx detected by runtime alerts
11:45 — Incident declared by incident-bot
11:50 — Autoscaler metrics lag identified
12:05 — Manual scale + kernel rollback initiated
12:12 — Fallback routing enabled for affected routes
12:20 — Error rate returns to baseline
12:40 — Monitoring to ensure stability
```

jordan: Also adding postmortem test checklist to keep this unique regression from recurring: add prompt-variance test, add in-flight metric delay simulation, run on small canary cluster pre-deploy.

delilah-support: For customer comms timeline: initial status page update now (I'll post), targeted private update to Acme + Borealis within 6 hours, full RCA within 48 hours. Legal looped in. :lock:

maria: For external status page copy — propose a short paragraph we can post after review: "We experienced intermittent timeouts for text-generation endpoints in us-west-2 due to a kernel-selection regression under certain prompt patterns. We applied fallback routing and manual scaling to restore service. We are investigating root cause and will share an RCA within 48h." Thoughts?

liu-cs: That looks good. Add an apology and a contact link for the affected customers.

alex: Confirmed next steps: calendar invite up, postmortem doc created, action tickets assigned. Please add any follow-ups to this thread and append logs to the doc. We'll use this thread for final sign-off on the customer RCA before sending.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled by alex — 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Reminder set for 30m prior. See INF-4826, INF-4827, DOC-945.

sre-jen: One more note — after fix, recommend a slow canary in us-west-2 with traffic mirroring for 48 hours to make sure kernel-selection fallback doesn't regress under real traffic. Adding to INF-4827.

delilah-support: I'll draft the initial status page update now and ping for approvals in here once ready.

alex: Thanks everyone. Great job getting things mitigated quickly. We'll aim to have the customer-facing RCA drafted and reviewed in the 48h window. :pray:
